La plupart des coffres-forts numériques se contentent d'un simple code et d'un dossier caché. Coffre Fort va beaucoup plus loin, avec une sécurité multicouche pensée comme une véritable application professionnelle :

👤 PROFILS MULTIPLES ILLIMITÉS
Créez autant de profils que vous le souhaitez — personnel, professionnel, famille — chacun totalement isolé, avec son propre code d'accès, son propre coffre, et ses propres réglages. Aucun profil ne peut accéder aux données d'un autre.

- Vérification d'intégrité de l'application

Limitez l'accès à votre coffre à un lieu précis. Hors de la zone autorisée, impossible de déverrouiller — même avec le bon code.

Importez et organisez vos images, vidéos, documents et musiques par catégorie, avec recherche, tri, miniatures et visualiseur intégré. Export sécurisé vers l'extérieur en un geste.

Un espace de notes chiffrées indépendant, pour vos informations sensibles que vous ne voulez confier à aucune autre application.

🌐 NAVIGATEUR PRIVÉ INTÉGRÉ
Naviguez sur le web sans laisser la moindre trace : aucun cookie, aucun historique, aucune donnée de formulaire conservée. Tout est effacé à la fermeture.

📊 TABLEAU DE BORD D'ACTIVITÉ
Visualisez l'usage de votre coffre : statistiques détaillées, graphique d'activité sur 7 jours, répartition par catégorie. Générez même un rapport PDF complet de votre inventaire.

Choisissez parmi plusieurs thèmes complets (sombre et clair) et personnalisez la couleur d'accent selon vos goûts.

🕵️ CAMOUFLAGE DE L'APPLICATION
Changez l'icône et le nom affichés sur votre écran d'accueil pour plus de discrétion, parmi plusieurs choix disponibles.

Exportez une sauvegarde protégée par un mot de passe de votre choix, restaurable même sur un nouvel appareil — contrairement à la plupart des coffres-forts qui vous enferment dans votre téléphone d'origine.

🛡️ NOTRE ENGAGEMENT VIE PRIVÉE

Coffre Fort ne collecte aucune donnée personnelle. Aucune publicité. Aucun tracker. Aucun SDK d'analyse. Support:

If you have a security Email set up before, you should be able to see a "Forgot Password" en-trance once you input the wrong password. Tap on the entrance and follow the instructions to reset your password.

results.title: Private Vault: Photos & Notes
results.snippet:
Private Vault is a private place for your photos, notes and files — one that lives on your device, not in someone else's cloud. No sign-up. No subscription. No one else's server.

Move photos out of your gallery, write notes nobody else will read, keep documents where they belong, and lock the whole thing behind your fingerprint.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

🖼️ Hide Photos
Bring photos into your vault from your gallery or straight from the camera. Choose to remove the originals as you import, so private pictures stop turning up when someone else scrolls through your phone.

📝 Notes
Write rich notes your way. Choose your font, paper colour, text size, line spacing and alignment. Pin the important ones to the top, archive the rest.

📎 Files
Save PDFs, images and documents directly into your vault. Everything stays on your device — no uploads, no waiting.

🔗 Links
Bookmark URLs and web pages with your own annotations. Never lose an important link again.

🎙️ Voice Memos
Record audio memos and play them back whenever you need them. Title and annotate each one, file it into folders, and find it again by name.

🔒 App Lock
Lock your vault behind a PIN, your fingerprint or your face. Set it to lock again automatically after you leave, so anyone who picks up your phone still cannot get in.

🏷️ Folders & Tags
Organise everything with folders and tags. Browse by type, filter by tag, or search across your whole vault at once.

🔍 Search Everything
One search covers your notes, files, links and voice memos together. Find what you need in seconds, no matter which pocket of the vault it landed in.

🧠 Connected Notes
Link notes to each other as you write, then open the graph view to see how your ideas actually connect.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY

Most note apps send your data to their servers the moment you start typing. Private Vault does not. Every photo, note, file and voice memo you create is stored locally on your device.

• Offline-first — works with no internet connection at all
• No account needed to use the app
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics — nothing is sent anywhere
• Protected by your PIN, your fingerprint and your device lock
• You always know exactly where your data lives

YOUR DATA, YOUR GOOGLE DRIVE

When you are ready to back up, your vault is encrypted with AES-256 on your device and sent straight to your own personal Google Drive — never to our servers. It is encrypted before it leaves your phone, so we cannot see it, store it, or reach it. It belongs entirely to you.

Signing in to Google is only needed if you choose to back up. Turn backup on, and you can restore your vault later on any device. Leave it off, and the app never touches the network.

You are never locked in.

WHO IT IS FOR

Private Vault is for anyone who wants a quiet, private place to keep things — without handing them to a tech company.

Anyone with photos they would rather not explain.
Students keeping lecture notes and research.
Professionals storing sensitive documents and ideas.
Writers collecting inspiration and drafts.
Anyone who is done trusting their private life to apps that profit from it.

Your vault. Your rules. Your data.

SafeInCloud Password Manager allows you to keep your logins, passwords, and other private info safe and secure in an encrypted database. You can synchronize your data with another phone, tablet, Mac or PC via your own cloud account.

KEY FEATURES
◆ Easy to Use
◆ Material Design
◆ Black Theme
◆ Strong Encryption (256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard)
◆ Cloud Synchronization (Google Drive, Dropbox, Microsoft OneDrive, NAS, WebDAV)
◆ Login with Fingerprint, Face, Retina
◆ Autofill in Apps
◆ Autofill in Chrome
◆ Browser Integration
◆ Wear OS App
◆ Password Strength Analysis
◆ Password Generator
◆ Free Desktop App (Windows, Mac)
◆ Automatic Data Import
◆ Cross-Platform

EASY TO USE
Try it yourself and enjoy an easy-to-use yet powerful user interface.

MATERIAL DESIGN
SafeInCloud was completely redesigned to match new Material Design user interface language by Google. In addition to the standard Light theme SafeInCloud also has a Dark theme option to help you saving a significant amount of battery life.

STRONG ENCRYPTION
Your data is always encrypted on a device and in a cloud with a strong 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). This algorithm is used by the U.S. Government for protection of a top secret information. AES is also widely adopted worldwide and became the de facto encryption standard.

CLOUD SYNCHRONIZATION
Your database is automatically synchronized with your own cloud account. Thus you can easily restore your entire database from a cloud to a new phone or computer (in case of a loss or an upgrade). Your phone, tablet and computer are also automatically synchronized between each other via a cloud.

LOGIN WITH FINGERPRINT
You can instantly unlock SafeInCloud with a fingerprint on devices with a fingerprint sensor. This feature is available on all Samsung devices. Devices from other manufacturers should have Android 6.0 or higher.

AUTOFILL IN APPS
You can autofill login and password fields into any app on your phone directly from SafeInCloud. You don't need to copy and paste them manually.

AUTOFILL IN CHROME
You can autofill logins and passwords on webpages in Chrome. For that you should enable SafeInCloud Autofill service in the phone's Accessibility settings.

WEAR OS APP
You can put some selected cards on your wrist to easily access them on the run. These could be your credit card PINs, door and locker codes.

PASSWORD STRENGTH ANALYSIS
SafeInCloud analyses your password strengths and shows a strength indicator next to each password. The strength indicator displays an estimated crack time for a password. All cards with weak passwords are marked with a red sign.

PASSWORD GENERATOR
The password generator helps you generating random and secure passwords. There is also an option to generate memorable, but still strong passwords.

FREE DESKTOP APP
Download a free Desktop application for Windows or Mac OS from www.safe-in-cloud.com to be able access your database on your computer. The Desktop application also makes data entry and editing fast and easy using a hardware keyboard.

AUTOMATIC DATA IMPORT
The Desktop application can automatically import your data from another password manager. You don't need to manually reenter all your passwords.

CROSS PLATFORM
SafeInCloud is available on the following platforms: Mac (OS X), iOS (iPhone and iPad), Windows, and Android.

results.title: Private Vault
results.snippet:
PrivateVault – Offline Encrypted File Vault & Manager

PrivateVault protects photos, videos, audio, PDFs, documents, archives, notes, and other sensitive files in a local encrypted vault. It works without an account, cloud service, ads, analytics, telemetry, or network access permission.

Unlike a basic file-hiding app, PrivateVault encrypts vault content and authenticated metadata on-device. Files remain in app-private storage, outside normal galleries, media scanners, and file-manager browsing.

Strong Password-Based Vault Protection

● AES-256-GCM: protects confidentiality and integrity; altered ciphertext fails authentication
● PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256: the current Free vault uses 500,000+ iterations, a fresh random 32-byte salt, and a 256-bit derived key
● Strict profiles: supported KDF parameters are versioned and allowlisted
● Legacy compatibility: supported 310,000+ iteration PBKDF2 vault credentials remain usable
● Vault passwords are not stored as plaintext or recoverable by PrivateVault
● Supports strong passwords of 8–127 characters, although minimum password length recommended is 15

Authenticated Local Storage

● PVL2 encrypted blobs: files are streamed in independently authenticated chunks with fresh random nonces and authenticated structural data
● PVMD metadata: file records, folders, active blob references, and repository state use a versioned authenticated format
● Encrypted local activity logs record supported vault actions

Encrypted File Manager

Import files and folders, search and sort content, use thumbnails and list views, select multiple items, export when needed, change the vault password, and remove items from the vault. Supported long operations provide foreground progress and cancellation controls.

Private Capture & Image Viewing

Capture photos, video, and audio from the app and store the results in the encrypted vault. Free includes private image viewing. Broader media, document, archive, and editing tools are available in PrivateVault PRO.

Biometric & Local Access Controls

Unlock with the vault password or supported secure biometrics through Android Keystore integration. Auto-lock, brute-force attempt limiting, vault reset, and local activity logs help control access without sending data to a server.

Argon2id Portable Backups

● Newer backups uses Argon2id v1.3 with 64 MiB memory, 3 passes, parallelism 4, a fresh random 32-byte salt, and a 256-bit derived key
● Backup headers, manifest data, and payloads are authenticated before restore activation
● Supported password-based backups can be restored during vault creation; advanced restore controls through settings page are a PRO feature

Encrypted File Sharing

Password-protected PPSH shared files use Argon2id and authenticated encryption independently of the Free vault KDF. Supported shared images can be opened after password authentication; other embedded formats remain subject to Free viewing limits.

Upgrade to Pv PRO (PrivateVault PRO)

PRO upgrade adds an Argon2id-protected live vault with a separate recovery code requirement, 2FA Unlock, Panic Gesture Lock, Intruder Selfie, advanced organization, broader file viewing, editing and scanning tools, Vault Safety Check, more themes, and PRO recovery-backup workflows.

PrivateVault created password-only backups versions are compatible with PRO. Current Pv PRO backups require both the vault password and saved recovery code, so they must be restored in Pv PRO.

Important Security Boundary

Vault content is encrypted at rest. Plaintext intentionally exported, shared, or opened in another app is outside the vault and no longer protected by PrivateVault encryption. Forgotten vault or backup passwords cannot be recovered. Security also depends on password strength, device integrity, Android security, and control of exported files.
